rows.label: Alex Honnold
rows.description: American professional mountaineer and extreme climber
rows.hook: scaled El Capitan without ropes, as shown in an Oscar-winning documentary

rows.label: Tony Hawk
rows.hook: became the first to land a 900 spin and inspired a best-selling video game series

rows.label: Felix Baumgartner
rows.description: Austrian skydiver, daredevil and BASE jumper (1969–2025)
rows.hook: freefell from the edge of space after a balloon ride, breaking the sound barrier

rows.label: Chloe Kim
rows.hook: won back-to-back Olympic halfpipe golds, the first as a teenager

rows.label: Dave Mirra
rows.hook: collected a record haul of X Games medals on two wheels

rows.label: Dean Potter
rows.hook: pushed rope-free ascents and wingsuit flights off cliffs in Yosemite

rows.label: Bethany Hamilton
rows.hook: returned to competition after losing an arm in a shark attack

rows.label: Amy Purdy
rows.hook: placed second on Dancing with the Stars after losing both legs to illness

rows.label: Travis Pastrana
rows.description: American professional motorsports competitor and stunt performer
rows.hook: landed the first double backflip on a dirt bike and stars in Nitro Circus stunts

rows.label: Kelly Slater
rows.hook: won a record eleven world titles and appeared on Baywatch

rows.label: Mick Fanning
rows.hook: fought off a shark that attacked him mid-heat on live television

rows.label: Jay Adams
rows.hook: was a Dogtown Z-Boys member known for an aggressive, low-slung style

rows.label: Janja Garnbret
rows.hook: won Olympic gold in both Tokyo and Paris

rows.label: Stacy Peralta
rows.hook: directed the documentary Dogtown and Z-Boys and the Bones Brigade films

rows.label: Andy Irons
rows.hook: won three world titles in a row while battling a legendary rival

rows.label: Rodney Mullen
rows.hook: invented the flatground ollie and kickflip, shaping modern street tricks

rows.label: Tony Alva
rows.hook: pioneered vertical riding in empty backyard pools as a founding pro of the Z-Boys
